correctness.rationale: The exact signed-sum/diagonal identity follows from Legendre polynomial telescoping and the displayed coefficient representation, with explicit n>=1 scope. The reciprocal-sum lemma is proved at every 2-adic valuation by odd-denominator pairing and the inverse-square unit sum. The formal exponential expansion has leading term 2n H_odd(n/2) of valuation 3v2(n)-1 at even n and all higher even terms have valuations at least 4v2(n), proving absence of cancellation; odd n have a unique odd leading term. The verifier independently checked all n<=1024 and 64 harmonic cases, but finite checks are not used as proof.

value.rationale: A full sharp divisibility law for the classical alternating central Delannoy weighted sum strengthens the previously published modulo-2n theorem on a natural infinite dyadic family and determines the exact valuation of a separately studied combinatorial diagonal sequence. The exponent 4v2(n)-1, particularly at n=2^t, is mathematically motivated by the known divisibility problem and proved by a structural reciprocal-sum identity, not by arbitrarily slicing a finite table. The result does not claim unrelated higher moments or odd primes.
